Step 1: Requirement is 1,200 units from one supplier, delivered in ≤20 days.

Step 2: Check each supplier against quantity and deadline:
- Alpha: Capacity 2,400 ≥ 1,200, but delivery 24 days > 20 days — does not qualify.
- Bravo: Capacity 1,200 ≥ 1,200, but delivery 35 days > 20 days — does not qualify.
- Cobalt: Capacity 1,700 ≥ 1,200, but delivery 35 days > 20 days — does not qualify.

Step 3: No supplier meets both the quantity and deadline requirements, so no landed cost qualifies.
